question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Account for'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: जवाब देना (का कारण बताना)
English Meaning: To explain the reason for
📝 Sentence Example:"You are accounted for your misdemeanour."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Account -> बैंक Account से पैसे कहाँ गए, इसका Account (हिसाब/कारण) देना पड़ता है।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Add up'?
options: To join or unite so as to increase in size/quantity
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: में जुड़ जाना जिससे माप/भार में बढ़ोतरी हो जाए
English Meaning: To join or unite so as to increase in size, quantity, quality or scope
📝 Sentence Example:"Add up these words to your word bank."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Add -> एक-एक करके Add करना जिससे कुल मात्रा (total) बढ़ जाए।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Answerable for'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: जवाबदेह होना
English Meaning: To be responsible for
📝 Sentence Example:"I am not answerable for this mistake."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Answer -> जो गलती का Answer (जवाब) देने के लिए बाध्य हो।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Ask after'?
options: to make inquiries about the health of (someone)
To retreat/ choose not to take action
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी के सेहत के बारे में पूछताछ करना
English Meaning: to make inquiries about the health of (someone)
📝 Sentence Example:"I met Alka and she was asking after you."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Ask + After -> मिलने के 'बाद' (After) किसी के बारे में 'पूछना' (Ask) यानी हाल-चाल लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Ask for (something)'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी वस्तु की माँग करना
English Meaning: to demand
📝 Sentence Example:"She was asking for a hike in her salary."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Ask + for -> मुझे ये 'चाहिए' (for), इसलिए मैं 'पूछ' (Ask) रहा हूँ = मांगना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Attend on'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सेवा करना
English Meaning: To serve
📝 Sentence Example:"Radhika has many servants to attend on her."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Attend -> राजा के पास नौकर होते हैं जो उसे Attend (उसकी सेवा) करते हैं।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Back off'?
options: To retreat/ to choose not to take action
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: दावा छोड़ देना/ पीछे हट जाना
English Meaning: To retreat/ to choose not to take action
📝 Sentence Example:"Finally she backed off from her claim on the property."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Back + Off -> अपनी बात या जगह से 'पीछे' (Back) हट (Off) जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Back out'?
options: To withdraw from something before completion/fail to keep promise
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कार्य पूरा होने से पहले पीछे हट जाना/ वादे से मुकर जाना
English Meaning: To withdraw from something before completion/to fail to keep promise
📝 Sentence Example:"You should not back out now as you had promised to help me."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Back + Out -> वादे से 'बाहर' (Out) हो जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Back up'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सहायता देना
English Meaning: To support
📝 Sentence Example:""We need back up because the soldiers are getting exhausted", the commander said."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Backup -> कंप्यूटर का Backup (डेटा बचाने के लिए सपोर्ट) या फौज़ का Backup।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bank upon/ Count on'?
options: To be reduced to its essentials
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: विश्वास करना या निर्भर होना
English Meaning: To rely on
📝 Sentence Example:"You cannot bank upon him as he may take you in any time."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bank -> जैसे हम अपने पैसों के लिए Bank पर निर्भर करते हैं।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bear down'?
options: To overthrow or crush by force
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: परास्त कर देना
English Meaning: To overthrow or crush by force
📝 Sentence Example:"We have to bear down our enemies."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bear + Down -> भालू (Bear) की तरह किसी को दबा (Down) कर कुचल देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bear upon'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: संबंधित होना/प्रासंगिक होना
English Meaning: To be relevant
📝 Sentence Example:"Will the new law bear upon the outcome of the case?"
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bear + Upon -> किसी मुद्दे पर असर (Bear) डालना मतलब वो प्रासंगिक है।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bear out'?
options: To carry to a successful conclusion
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सही साबित करने में सहायक होना
English Meaning: To support the truth/substantiate
📝 Sentence Example:"This document will bear out your claim on this building."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bear + Out -> सच्चाई को बाहर (Out) लाकर साबित करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bear up'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सहना
English Meaning: To withstand stress or difficulty
📝 Sentence Example:"Everyone has to bear up some difficulties."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bear + Up -> मुश्किलों का भार उठाकर (Up) सहना (Bear)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bear with'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बर्दाश्त करना
English Meaning: To tolerate with someone
📝 Sentence Example:"Our server is down. Kindly bear with us."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bear + With -> किसी के 'साथ' (With) धीरज रखकर सहना (Bear)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Become of'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: घटित होना (किसी व्यक्ति के साथ)
English Meaning: To happen
📝 Sentence Example:"I wonder, what became of my old friends."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Become -> 'उसका क्या हुआ?' (What became of him?)

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Boil down to'?
options: To be reduced to its essentials
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सार निकालना/संक्षिप्त करना
English Meaning: To be reduced to its essentials.
📝 Sentence Example:"Every business boils down to just one thing i.e profit."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Boil + Down -> पानी उबाल (Boil) कर उसे गाढ़ा और कम (Down) कर देना (सार निकालना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Branch out'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: फैल जाना
English Meaning: To spread
📝 Sentence Example:"We are going to branch out our business soon."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Branch -> पेड़ की शाखाओं (Branches) की तरह बिज़नेस को फैलाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break down' (of machine)?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: काम करना बंद कर देना
English Meaning: To stop working
📝 Sentence Example:"The bus broke down on the way so I could not reach the station in time."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break -> मशीन टूट (Break) कर नीचे (Down) बैठ गई।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break down' (of person)?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: हिम्मत/हौसला खो देना
English Meaning: To lose control (emotionally or mentally)
📝 Sentence Example:"We should not break down in adverse situation."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break -> इंसान का अंदर से टूट (Break) जाना और रोने लगना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break forth'?
options: To come to view/to appear suddenly
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अचानक उजागर होना
English Meaning: To come to view/to appear suddenly
📝 Sentence Example:"Chaos might break forth if the police fail to control the situation."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Forth -> सीमाओं को तोड़कर आगे (Forth) अचानक सामने आ जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break in on'?
options: To interrupt a conversation or discussion/ to intrude
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: खलल डालना
English Meaning: To interrupt a conversation or discussion/ to intrude.
📝 Sentence Example:"The conversation between Ali and Sona was going on when Rahul broke in on it."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + In -> किसी की बात के 'बीच में' (In) घुसकर तोड़ना (Break)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break into'?
options: To enter or open a place or vehicle forcibly
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: जबरदस्ती प्रवेश करना
English Meaning: To enter or open a place or vehicle forcibly
📝 Sentence Example:"The thief broke into the house."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Into -> ताला 'तोड़कर' (Break) घर के 'अंदर' (Into) घुसना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break off'?
options: To stop suddenly/ to end a relationship
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सहसा रूक जाना/ संबंध खत्म करना
English Meaning: To stop suddenly/ to end a relationship.
📝 Sentence Example:"He broke off in the middle of his lecture yesterday."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Off -> बात या रिश्ते को बीच से तोड़ (Break) कर खत्म (Off) कर देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break out'?
options: To pass through the shortest way
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अचानक फैलना
English Meaning: To start suddenly (disease, war etc.)
📝 Sentence Example:"Dengue has broken out in Delhi."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Out -> बीमारी का अचानक पिंजरा तोड़कर बाहर (Out) आ जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break up'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: भंग होना (भीड़ आदि का)
English Meaning: To end/disperse
📝 Sentence Example:"Seeing the police the crowd broke up."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Up -> भीड़ का टूटकर बिखर जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Break up' (relationship)?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अलग हो जाना
English Meaning: To separate (of a relationship etc.)
📝 Sentence Example:"They have broken up and now marriage is not on the cards."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Breakup -> लवर्स का अलग होना सबको पता है (Break up)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Breakthrough'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: रहस्य की खोज करना / बड़ी सफलता
English Meaning: To discover a secret / major success
📝 Sentence Example:"There is no breakthrough in the robbery case."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Break + Through -> मुश्किल दीवार को तोड़कर (Through) सफलता (राज़) पाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring about'?
options: To sell off/ get rid of
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: होने का कारण होना
English Meaning: To cause to happen
📝 Sentence Example:"The sound economic policies brought about a revival of the company."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring -> कोई बदलाव 'लेकर आना' (Bring)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring along'?
options: To keep thinking or talking about
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: साथ लाना
English Meaning: To take someone/something
📝 Sentence Example:"Bring your son along with you when you come here."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Along -> अपने 'साथ' (Along) लाना (Bring)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring down'?
options: To overthrow (a government)/to reduce in position
To start or get involved in
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सत्ता से नीचे गिराना/ पद में कम करना
English Meaning: To overthrow (a government)/to reduce in position
📝 Sentence Example:"The sting operation can bring down the government."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Down -> सरकार को 'नीचे' (Down) गिरा देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring forth'?
options: To use as a last resort
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: उत्पन्न/ पैदा करना
English Meaning: To give birth to/produce
📝 Sentence Example:"Corruption brings forth poverty."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Forth -> परिणाम को आगे (Forth) लेकर आना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring forward'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रस्तुत करना
English Meaning: To present
📝 Sentence Example:"The judge asked me to bring forward some proof against him."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Forward -> सबूतों को जज के 'सामने' (Forward) लाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring in'?
options: To overthrow or crush by force
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कमाई कराना/पैदा करना
English Meaning: To produce, yield or earn
📝 Sentence Example:"Our company will bring in huge profit this month."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + In -> पैसे घर के 'अंदर' (In) लाना यानी कमाई करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring off'?
options: To carry to a successful conclusion
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: करने में सफल होना
English Meaning: To carry to a successful conclusion
📝 Sentence Example:"The government has brought off changes in the Land Bill."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Off -> मुश्किल काम को अंजाम (Off) तक ले जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring on'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: का कारण बनना
English Meaning: To cause to happen
📝 Sentence Example:"The new law will surely bring on positive changes in the society."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + On -> बीमारी या बदलाव को 'ऑन' (चालू) कर देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring out'?
options: To present to the public/to make some quality noticeable
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रस्तुत करना/कुछ विशेष जानकारी में लाना
English Meaning: To present to the public/to make some quality noticeable
📝 Sentence Example:"His evidence has convincingly brought out several facts before the court."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Out -> छुपे हुए टैलेंट या किताब को 'बाहर' (Out) लाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring over'?
options: To bring someone to one's side
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अपने पक्ष में करना
English Meaning: To bring someone to one's side
📝 Sentence Example:"We should not try to bring him over as he is not a reliable person."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Over -> किसी को अपनी तरफ (Over to my side) ले आना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring round'?
options: To bring to one's senses/to make one agree
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: होश में लाना/अपने अनुकूल बनाना
English Meaning: To bring to one's senses/to make one agree to one's opinion
📝 Sentence Example:"The Trade Union succeeded in bringing the management round to their point of view."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Round -> बेहोश को 'घुमा' (Round) कर वापस होश में लाना या मना लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring under'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: वश में करना
English Meaning: To control
📝 Sentence Example:"The East India company brought many provinces under its control."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Under -> किसी को अपने 'अंडर' (नीचे) ले आना यानी वश में करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Bring up'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: उठाना (मुद्दा इत्यादि)/ पालन-पोषण करना
English Meaning: To raise/ to rear/to increase
📝 Sentence Example:"She was brought up in a very poor family."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Bring + Up -> बच्चे को 'बड़ा' (Up) करना या मुद्दे को उठाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call on'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: मुलाकात करना (किसी से)
English Meaning: To visit (a person)
📝 Sentence Example:"The PM will call on the flood victims tomorrow."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + On -> किसी इंसान के 'ऊपर' (On) जाकर मिलना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call at'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: मुलाकात करना (किसी के घर/ऑफिस इत्यादि जाकर)
English Meaning: To visit (a place)
📝 Sentence Example:"Last Sunday I called at your home but you were not at available."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + At -> किसी 'जगह' (At) पर जाकर मिलना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call for'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: मांग करना
English Meaning: To demand (answer, explanation)
📝 Sentence Example:"This irresponsible behaviour calls for strict actions against her."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + For -> किसी काम 'के लिए' (For) आवाज़ उठाना (मांगना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call forth'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रतिक्रिया पैदा करना
English Meaning: To produce (a reaction)elicit
📝 Sentence Example:"The arbitrary Bill called forth a strong reaction."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + Forth -> किसी के अंदर से रिएक्शन 'बाहर' (Forth) बुलाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call in'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बुलावा भेजना
English Meaning: To summon/ send for
📝 Sentence Example:"She is too ill to call in a doctor."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + In -> डॉक्टर को घर के 'अंदर' (In) बुलाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call off'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: रद्द करना
English Meaning: To cancel
📝 Sentence Example:"The meeting was called off without any reason."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + Off -> जो मीटिंग बुलाई थी उसे 'बंद' (Off) कर दिया (रद्द)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call up'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: याद करना
English Meaning: To recall
📝 Sentence Example:"The victim tried to call up the actual sequence of the incidents but she couldn't."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + Up -> पुरानी यादों को दिमाग में 'ऊपर' (Up) लाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Call upon/on'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कुछ करने या बोलने के लिए आमंत्रित करना
English Meaning: To invite to do something
📝 Sentence Example:"I call upon you to furnish the details of your income."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Call + Upon -> स्टेज पर बोलने के लिए 'पुकारना'।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Carry away'?
options: To arouse too much emotion/ zeal
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: उत्तेजित करना/भावुक करना
English Meaning: To arouse too much emotion/ zeal
📝 Sentence Example:"I was carried away by the emotional scenes of the movie."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Carry + Away -> भावनाएं उसे 'बहा कर ले गईं' (Carried away)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb 'Carry off'?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कार्यान्वित करना (सफलतापूर्वक)
English Meaning: To execute
📝 Sentence Example:"He carried off the responsibility successfully."
